name: io.github.tonyyang0504/mercari_shops_jp-mcp
description: Mercari Shops (JP) (ecommerce channels): me, update_listing, end_listing, set_inventory, list_orders

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_MERCARI_SHOPS_JP_ACCESS_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Personal API Access Token issued on your mercari Shops shop administration page; sent as Authorization: Bearer.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_MERCARI_SHOPS_JP_USER_AGENT
environmentVariables.description: User-Agent required by mercari Shops: <API_CLIENT_NAME>/<VERSION>, where API_CLIENT_NAME is the value Mercari assigns to your company at contract (e.g. EXAMPLE_SHOP/1.0.0); requests without the correct User-Agent are restricted.
